reason: My register has never lost a bill and my staff and I know it inside out; an English app on every stylist's phone means slowing down on Sundays and festival rush just to type numbers and take selfies. Rs 999 every month plus Rs 4,999 upfront for something I don't feel I need is too much.
objection: It is only in English. My stylists and half my customers are more comfortable in Hindi, and if the staff can't use it fast in the rush they will go back to the register and I will be paying for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If it came fully in Hindi, with no setup fee, and another salon owner I know showed me it actually caught cash going missing from the drawer.
